messages:
Maria B: Quick heads-up — scheduled deploy for optimizer-service v2.14 tonight at 23:00 PT (about 2h). Low-risk rollout but includes the KV-cache persistence toggle and a minor config tweak for batching. Oncall coverage: Jon C (primary) + Alex P (secondary). Please watch canary for the first 15m.

Jon C: Ack. I'll be online for the window and watching stderr + 5xx metrics.

Alex P: I'll keep my phone on. If canary trips, what's our rollback command?

Maria B: Rollback plan: revert the image and disable cache toggle. Quick commands:
```
# rollback image
kubectl set image deployment/optimizer optimizer=redwood/optimizer:v2.13 --record
# disable cache toggle via configmap
kubectl patch configmap optimizer-config -p '{"data":{"kv_persistence":"off"}}'
```
Keep an eye on mem usage — v2.14 has a known short-lived mem spike in stress tests.

Priya S: Any DB migrations or schema changes?

Maria B: No DB changes. It's purely runtime + config. We will do a rolling restart (no downtime expected).

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy optimizer-service:v2.14 at 2026-06-04T06:00:00Z (23:00 PT). Canary nodes: optimizer-canary-1..3.

Sam L: FYI I added the new canary panel to the ops dashboard (Ops > Services > Optimizer > Canary). I also set an alert for error_rate > 1% or 95th latency > 800ms.

Jon C: Thanks Sam. I'll mute non-critical noise and rely on these alerts. If we see >1% errors for 2 consecutive minutes I'll cut the rollout and hit rollback.

Alex P: Noted. I'll be ready to escalate to infra if kernel OOMs show up (past runs had rare OOM on 16GB nodes).

Maria B: Good call — we added a soft node autoscale rule but it won't help instant OOMs. If OOMs appear, rollback immediately.

Priya S: Are we in any freeze window later tonight? Product said last code freeze at 22:00 PT, so we should be clear.

Maria B: Correct — freeze ended at 22:00 PT. This deploy is within the allowed window. Posting runbook link after deploy starts.

Jon C: Quick note for watchers: watch these graphs: canary error_rate, canary_95p_latency, pod_memory_rss, and redis_kv_p99.

Alex P: I'll post the rollback commands in #eng-ops if needed, and ping infra.

Maria B: Thanks everyone. Ping me directly if you want to swap coverage. Otherwise I'll post a short update in the morning with canary results. :thumbsup:
